---
title: "MB1A Practical 1 - brain data"
author: "Megan Croxton"
---

I am calculating the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in humans, pigs and mice.
That is the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus.

Human

```{r}
total_elevated_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_elevated_human)
```

Pig

```{r}
total_elevated_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_elevated_pig)
```

Mouse

```{r}
total_elevated_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_elevated_mouse)
```
The highest number of genes with elevated expression was in humans.
